name: Wood joinery
description: Woodworking joints between boards: mortise and tenon, grooves, half laps, dowels and box joints.

rail.title: Rail (empty = selection)
rail.description: Name of the body that gets the tenon. Its end touches the stile. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

stile.title: Stile (empty = selection)
stile.description: Name of the body that gets the mortise. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

oneOf.title: Classic
oneOf.description: A blind mortise. The tenon has a shoulder on each edge.

oneOf.title: Haunched
oneOf.description: A blind mortise with a short haunch near the end of the stile.

oneOf.title: Through
oneOf.description: The tenon goes through the whole stile.

oneOf.title: Bridle
oneOf.description: An open slot at the end of the stile.

thickness.title: Tenon thickness
thickness.description: Empty: a third of the rail thickness.

length.title: Tenon length
length.description: Empty: two thirds of the stile, to the nearest 5 mm. The whole stile for through and bridle.

shoulder.title: Shoulder
shoulder.description: On each edge of the rail width. Empty: the cheek width, at most a fifth of the rail width.

haunch_width.title: Haunch width
haunch_width.description: Haunched only. Empty: a fifth of the rail width.

haunch_depth.title: Haunch depth
haunch_depth.description: Haunched only. Empty: the tenon thickness.

glue_relief.title: Glue relief
glue_relief.description: Extra depth under a blind tenon. Empty: 2 mm.

clearance.title: Clearance
clearance.description: Gap around the tenon in the mortise. Empty: none.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Shift of the tenon across the rail thickness. Empty: centred.

align.title: Align the boards first
align.description: On: moves the rail first, so that its end lies on the stile.

body.title: Board (empty = selection)
body.description: Name of the body to groove. Empty: the selected board.

face.title: Face (empty = selection)
face.description: The face to cut into. The groove runs along its longer side. Empty: the selected face.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: From the edge of the face nearest the origin to the groove. Empty: centred. Zero makes a rabbet.

stop_start.title: Stop at start
stop_start.description: Wood left uncut at the end nearest the origin. Empty: the groove runs out.

stop_end.title: Stop at end
stop_end.description: Wood left uncut at the other end. Empty: the groove runs out.

first.title: First board (empty = selection)
first.description: Name of a body. The two boards must overlap where the joint goes. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

second.title: Second board (empty = selection)
second.description: Name of the body that crosses the first one. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

depth.title: Depth in the first board
depth.description: Empty: half the thickness. The second board loses the rest.

flip.title: Swap sides
flip.description: Off: the first board is cut on its side away from the origin. On: on the other side.

align.title: Align the boards first
align.description: On: moves the first board into the plane of the second one first.

first.title: First board (empty = selection)
first.description: Name of a body. A face of it touches the second board. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

second.title: Second board (empty = selection)
second.description: Name of the body the first one touches. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

diameter.title: Diameter
diameter.description: Empty: 6, 8, 10 or 12 mm, at most half the thinner side of the contact.

length.title: Dowel length
length.description: Empty: five diameters. Half goes in each board, less in a thin one.

count.title: Number of dowels
count.description: Empty: two when there is room, then one every 96 mm or so.

glue_relief.title: Glue relief
glue_relief.description: Extra depth at the bottom of each hole. Empty: 1 mm.

dowel_bodies.title: Add the dowels
dowel_bodies.description: On: each dowel is a new body. Off: holes only.

align.title: Align the boards first
align.description: On: moves the first board against the second one first.

first.title: First board (empty = selection)
first.description: Name of the body that gets the fingers. Its end touches the second board. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

second.title: Second board (empty = selection)
second.description: Name of the body that gets the sockets. The fingers go through it. Empty: the selection, in the order picked.

count.title: Number of divisions
count.description: Fingers and gaps across the width. Empty: the odd number nearest to square fingers.

swap.title: Start with a finger
swap.description: Off: the first board starts with a gap at the edge nearest the origin. On: with a finger.

align.title: Align the boards first
align.description: On: moves the first board against the nearest corner of the second one.
